faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes Vario 508D/510D use?
faqLeft.a: The Vario 508D/510D uses either the OM602 2.9-litre five-cylinder diesel or the OM611 2.2-litre four-cylinder diesel. Both were fitted throughout the production run from 1996 to 2013. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your van has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes Vario 508D/510D engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,200, for either engine code. Exact price depends on condition and parts required - submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Vario 508D/510D?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the OM602 or the OM611 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM602 Vario 508D/510D engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chain components, timing gears, injector seals, and gaskets as standard on every OM602 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM611 Vario 508D/510D engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The OM611 shares the same wear pattern as the OM602, and we service it to the same standard.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Vario 508D/510D engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Vario 508D/510D if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Vario 508D/510D engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your van arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Vario owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty - often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
